info.name: Fetch Operating Reserve Offer Control data for a given date that is 60 days prior to current date.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Any date between 2012-10-04 and current date (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

items.docs:
Fetch Operating Reserve Offer Control data for Date(startDate (yyyy-MM-dd))

The Operating Reserve Offer Control data is available 60 days after the date of the report, first available from October 4, 2012.
